description: Implement Order Tracking, Disputes (user side), Reviews & Ratings, Coupons/Rewards, Product Categories, Seller Profiles, Services, and Subscriptions/Plans features.
steps: 1. Create lib/features/orders/ with: providers/orders_provider.dart (fetch user orders with items, track status), screens/orders_screen.dart (list user orders), screens/order_detail_screen.dart (order details with timeline UI: Placed -> Confirmed -> Shipped -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered, show order items, total, address).

2. Create lib/features/disputes/ with: providers/disputes_provider.dart (CRUD for disputes table), screens/disputes_screen.dart (list user disputes with status), screens/raise_dispute_screen.dart (form: order_id/campaign_id reference, subject, description, submit to disputes table). Disputes table: id, user_id, order_id, campaign_id, subject, description, status (open/investigating/resolved/closed), resolution, created_at, resolved_at.

3. Create lib/features/reviews/ with: providers/reviews_provider.dart (fetch reviews for product/creator, submit review), screens/reviews_screen.dart (list reviews for a product), widgets/star_rating_widget.dart (interactive star rating 1-5), widgets/review_card.dart (display single review). Reviews table: id, user_id, target_id, target_type (product/creator), rating (1-5), comment, created_at.

4. Create lib/features/coupons/ with: providers/coupons_provider.dart (validate coupon code, fetch reward points from reward_points table), screens/coupons_screen.dart (list available coupons, show reward points balance, redeem points). Integrate coupon application in checkout flow (update checkout_screen.dart to have apply coupon field).

5. Create lib/features/categories/ with: providers/categories_provider.dart (fetch from product_categories table which has id, name, parent_id for hierarchy), widgets/category_filter_widget.dart. Update shop_screen.dart to use proper categories from DB instead of hardcoded strings.

6. Create lib/features/sellers/ with: providers/sellers_provider.dart (fetch seller_profiles), screens/seller_profile_screen.dart (show seller info, their products). Update product detail to show seller info. seller_profiles table: id, user_id, store_name, description, logo_url, rating, total_sales, created_at.

7. Create lib/features/services/ with: providers/services_provider.dart, screens/services_screen.dart (hub for: Media Kit Generator - stats summary card, Rate Calculator - followers x engagement -> suggested rate, UGC Creator marketplace listing, Analytics dashboard with charts placeholder). Services table: id, user_id, service_type, title, description, price, is_active, created_at.

8. Create lib/features/subscriptions/ with: providers/subscriptions_provider.dart (fetch subscription_plans, user_subscriptions), screens/subscriptions_screen.dart (show available plans with pricing, subscribe button, manage active subscription). subscription_plans table: id, name, price, features (jsonb), duration_days. user_subscriptions: id, user_id, plan_id, status, starts_at, ends_at.
9. Add all new routes to app_router.dart: /orders, /orders/:id, /disputes, /disputes/raise, /reviews/:targetId, /coupons, /seller/:id, /services, /subscriptions.
10. Update profile_screen.dart to add menu items for Orders and Subscriptions. Update shop product detail to show reviews and seller info.
acceptance_criteria: Order tracking shows timeline UI with proper status progression
Disputes can be raised with form and tracked in list
Reviews show star ratings and can be submitted for products
Coupons screen shows available codes and reward points balance
Product categories load from DB with hierarchy support
Seller profiles show store info and their products
Services hub shows Media Kit, Rate Calculator, UGC marketplace, Analytics
Subscriptions show available plans with subscribe/manage actions
All routes properly configured in app_router.dart
flutter analyze passes on all new files
verification: Read all new files and verify proper Dart syntax and imports
Verify integration points (checkout coupon, product detail reviews/seller)
